effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC to the vault (safeTransferFrom from caller). The vault then supplies it to Morpho Blue markets.
The receiver gets newly minted sbMorphoUSDC shares. The vault price sets the number (floor rounding) and the call sets no minimum.
The call first mints performance fee shares to the fee recipient. This changes the share price used for the signer.
formats.shown: Deposit: the USDC amount, the share ticker sbMorphoUSDC, and the address that receives the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many shares the receiver gets, and the code sets no minimum
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. The amount depends on vault storage and is not in the calldata. The descriptor shows only 'Share ticker' sbMorphoUSDC.

findings.title: deposit intent 'Deposit' does not name USDC or the vault, so the intent alone is vague
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: `"intent": "Deposit"` with no interpolatedIntent. The asset and the vault only appear in the fields.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Deposit USDC into sbMorphoUSDC vault" and add an interpolatedIntent: "Deposit {assets} for shares to {receiver}".

effects: The receiver gets exactly `shares` sbMorphoUSDC vault shares.
The signer pays a USDC amount that the code computes from the vault price, rounded up, with no maximum bound. The USDC goes to the vault and on to Morpho Blue.
The call first mints performance fee shares to the fee recipient, which changes the price.
formats.shown: Mint: 'Deposit asset USDC' as a fixed label, the number of shares minted, and the address that receives them.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDC leaves the signer, and the code sets no maximum
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);`. The descriptor only has the field 'Deposit asset' = $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker (raw).
findings.fix: Rename the field 'Deposit asset' to 'You pay (amount set by vault price)' so the signer knows USDC leaves.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say the signer pays USDC for the shares
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`. ERC4626._deposit runs `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets)`.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Buy vault shares with USDC" and add an interpolatedIntent: "Mint {shares} paid in USDC to {receiver}".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault sends exactly `assets` USDC to the receiver. It pulls the USDC from Morpho Blue markets.
The vault burns sbMorphoUSDC shares from `owner`. The vault price sets the number (ceil rounding) and the call sets no maximum.
When the signer is not the owner, the call spends the signer's share allowance from the owner by the number of shares burned.
The call first mints performance fee shares to the fee recipient.
formats.shown: Withdraw: the exact USDC amount, the receiver, and the owner.

findings.title: withdraw does not show the sbMorphoUSDC shares burned from the owner
findings.evidence: Case 0: the signer sends out 937596.578920432085188814 sbMorphoUSDC (burn to 0x0). The screen only shows 'Withdraw exactly 1000000 USDC', 'To', 'Owner'. MetaMorpho.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);`. The amount comes from storage.
findings.fix: Add a constant field {"label": "Shares burned from owner", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"} so the signer sees which position shrinks.

findings.title: withdraw screen does not name the vault, so the reader could not tell which vault it is
findings.evidence: Case 0 reader, unsure: 'Which vault or contract this is; only the app name Gauntlet is shown'. Descriptor withdraw format: intent "Withdraw". It has no field with vaultTicker, while deposit has one.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Withdraw USDC from sbMorphoUSDC vault" and add an interpolatedIntent: "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver}".

cases.notes: The screen shows the USDC received (1,000,000 USDC to the signer) correctly. It does not show the 937,596.58 sbMorphoUSDC shares burned. The reader guessed that a vault position shrinks but did not know the amount or the token.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` sbMorphoUSDC from `owner`. When the signer is not the owner, it spends the signer's share allowance from the owner.
The receiver gets a USDC amount that the code computes from the vault price (floor rounding), with no minimum. The vault pulls it from Morpho Blue.
The call first mints performance fee shares to the fee recipient.
formats.shown: Redeem: the number of shares to redeem, the receiver, and the owner. Nothing says USDC arrives.

findings.title: redeem never says the receiver gets USDC: the screen names only the shares
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, ..., Math.Rounding.Floor); _withdraw(...)`, then ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets)`. The descriptor's redeem fields are only 'Shares to redeem', 'To', 'Owner', while mint shows underlyingTicker.
findings.fix: Add {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and set the intent to "Redeem vault shares for USDC".

findings.title: redeem does not show how much USDC arrives, and the code sets no minimum
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem computes `assets` from totalSupply and newTotalAssets in storage. No calldata value bounds it.
